phase: Two New Text Font Styles -- Marker Handwriting + Shape-Mosaic Fill
milestone: The World Builder half of the governing request: 'i want these fonts available in builder as well studio. alphabets, numbers should also be part of shapes.' The 'Permanent Marker' Font Family option is now wired into World Builder v2's own Text-content font lists, and the deterministic Shape-Mosaic Fill Style algorithm (a canvas glyph-as-clip-mask + source-in composite technique -- never a static reproduction of one name, working for the full A-Z alphabet and 0-9 digits, any typed content, any font) is mirrored by hand into services/engineRuntime.js from root Studio's own renderer/slideRenderer.js implementation, kept in lockstep per this codebase's established two-rendering-engines discipline (see root build-info.json's own entry for the full account).
slice: js/services/experienceSchema.js gained the shapeFill default field; js/projectModel.js's Engine Adapter mirrors a Text Experience's shapeFill choice onto its compiled Scene Layer exactly like every other typography field (rotation/opacity/fontWeight/etc.) already does; js/services/builder.js's compile step carries shapeFill through onto the published Theme's Layer Pack entry -- no Theme Contract/schema redesign, purely one more additive field riding the identical, already-proven typography-field pipeline. js/worldBuilderApp.js's Text content section Inspector gained a Fill Style (Solid/Shapes) toggle control matching root Studio's own quick-edit popups. Verified via verify_font_shapefill.js (37/0 PASS, spanning both surfaces) plus every existing rotation/text-fidelity suite (verify_text_rotation.js, verify_text_rotation_pivot.js, verify_text_align_fidelity_fix.js, verify_text_newline_fix.js, verify_rotation_publish_honored.js, verify_stretch_fit.js) confirmed passing unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model change; confined to js/projectModel.js, js/worldBuilderApp.js, and js/services/{builder,engineRuntime,experienceSchema}.js.
